clips.text: A pixel reel is a short cartoon that explains one thing. No waffle. No small print. Just the bits that matter.
Each scene says one thing, then moves on. So there's never much to hold in your head.
The words are big and plain. Short enough to take in at a glance. And I read every one of them out loud.
And you're the boss. Pause, go back, or watch it twice. Nobody's counting.
